packageRules.description: Hold Babel below 8. react-scripts (CRA 5.0.1) calls Babel's createConfigItem synchronously, and Babel 8 made it callback-based, so the client build dies with 'Starting from Babel 8.0.0, the createConfigItem function expects a callback'. CRA is unmaintained and will never ship a fix. Remove this rule only when the client moves off react-scripts.
